title: Shadow target
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Reference image: use ONLY the design on the small playing card held above the glove, especially its charcoal scuffed surface, warm aged-brass concentric target with pointed cardinal arms, fine crimson border and corner scrollwork. Create a NEW flat production card-back design inspired by that card. Remove the hand and purple energy entirely. One single rectangular portrait card back, straight-on orthographic view, no perspective, no mockup, no rounded outer corners, no cast shadows, no text or logos. Aspect ratio exactly 5:7. Full-bleed dark charcoal texture across the entire image; centered design, equal left/right margins and equal top/bottom margins. Keep ALL border ornament at least 7% of canvas width from left and right and 5% of canvas height from top and bottom. Clear dark breathing room around the whole decorative frame. Main emblem exactly at geometric center. Gritty painted realism with fine weathered engravings and patinated metal, crisp readable design at physical poker-card size. Overall ornamental layout should be symmetric under 180-degree rotation. No purple glow.  Closest recreation of the reference: elegant thin double crimson line frame with compact red scroll flourishes mirrored in all four corners; large antique brass target medallion at center with concentric broken rings and four elongated pointed crosshair arms. Worn black leather/grained charcoal ground with fine scratches. Restrained red, antique brass and black. Keep generous space between center emblem and border.
